purpose: Review official Taiwan/NLSC and Yuanlin Land Office channels for safe anonymous cadastral geometry and stable parcel identifiers.
summary: Official Yuanlin Land Office pages establish local cadastral custody and services. NLSC public capabilities and DescribeFeatureType expose the CADAS_MERGE cadastral layer and multipolygon schema, but the bounded anonymous feature request returned Permission Denied and the exact-point viewer overlay returned a no-land-number message. No geometry or native parcel identity was retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Traditional-Chinese discovery queries, outcomes and actual URLs are recorded in the city record.
requestOutcomes: NLSC viewer, capabilities and schema loaded anonymously. The exact bounded CADAS_MERGE feature request was denied; the exact-point overlay request returned [{"msg":"地號查詢無資料!"}]. Yuanlin Land Office pages loaded and documented local services. No safe parcel feature response was obtained.
attemptedRoutes: NLSC WFS bounded GetFeature request at the unchanged WUP point
NLSC landmaps cadastral overlay request at the unchanged WUP point
Changhua County Yuanlin Land Office official service and duties pages
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [23.9313794330103, 120.542206563103] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No Yuanlin city boundary or complete citywide coverage was established for an open parcel geometry service.
No parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, source row or feature CRS was retrieved or retained.
Local registry custody and a public viewer/schema are not proof of unrestricted anonymous vector access.
Permission Denied, no-land-number result, map extent behavior, timeout, login wall or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains required.
